Rolex GMT-Master II 126710BLNR and 126710BLRO: how a GMT hand works, explained.

A 24-hour hand shows a second time zone, and the bezel lets you match any hour to it. Per Gear Patrol.

Prices: Timex TW6A07200 USD 1,450 (Timex, 26 Nov 2026). Rolex 126710BLNR USD 11,800 (B&C Clark, 25 Nov 2026). Rolex 126710BLRO USD 33,200 (Avian & Co, 26 Nov 2026). Prices are retail and change.
